description: Canonical bidirectional mapping between spec YAML property types and Figma display types. This is the single source of truth — all rules, scripts, and agents must reference this file instead of duplicating the table. Mirrors the type mapping decision table in component-spec-yaml.mdc.

normalization.note: Type comparison is case-insensitive. 'Enum', 'ENUM', and 'enum' are all equivalent. Normalize to lowercase before lookup.

aliases.note: Figma sometimes surfaces 'variant' as the axis type. Coerce to 'enum' before spec storage.

enum.default_format: One of the values[] entries, or "TBD" if unknown

boolean.default_format: true or false (unquoted YAML boolean), or "TBD" if unknown

instance_swap.default_format: Component name string, or "TBD" if unknown

invalid_type_behavior.action: Stop; report error SPEC01 with the invalid type value; do not render the property.

ready_spec_constraints.description: Additional constraints that apply when status is 'ready'. All must pass before a spec may be promoted.

rules.description: All property defaults must be concrete (not the string 'TBD').
For enum properties, default must match one of the values[] entries.
values[] must not contain 'TBD' as an entry. A values:["TBD"] array does not satisfy the concrete-default requirement regardless of whether the default technically matches.

figma_node_id.description: Figma node ID format: two integers separated by a colon (e.g. 123:456).
figma_node_id.note: docs-validator.mjs uses the more permissive /^[A-Za-z0-9]+:[A-Za-z0-9]+$/ pattern. The canonical pattern here (digits-only) matches all real Figma node IDs observed in this project and should be preferred in new validators.
